raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: Instead of executing the browsing task (opening Wayback snapshots and extracting menu items), WebSurfer shifted into giving meta-instructions and refined-search prompts, failing to navigate to or load specific archived pages. This early deviation led to repeated loops of generic searches and no concrete retrieval or comparison of the March 22 and April 21, 2021 menus, directly causing the failure to produce the required dish.
